description: P26 opt-in native ranking and budgeted delivery of shared-pool training evidence.

microtheory.name: useful_evidence_selection
microtheory.description: Rank only epoch-valid native learning signals, issue one budgeted answer-free training opportunity, and close it from actual receipt plus later behavior.

rules.name: ues_capture_native_prediction_disagreement
rules.comment: Create an epoch-bound selector signal only when a native prediction is contradicted by an observed training counterexample.

rules.name: ues_capture_recurring_native_residuals
rules.comment: Recurring-residual signals require two distinct observed counterexamples in the same source/model/frame context.

rules.name: ues_capture_verified_progress_for_related_training_opportunity
rules.comment: Carry only receipt-backed native-state and later-behavior changes into a same-epoch evidence opportunity.

rules.name: ues_reopen_opportunity_after_native_epoch_change
rules.comment: A terminal evidence key is reconsidered only after its source, model, or frame epoch changes.

rules.name: ues_request_shared_budget_for_top_training_opportunity
rules.comment: Select one answer-free opportunity natively and fund selection work from the common ThinkingBudget.

rules.name: ues_emit_selected_opportunity_after_budget_approval
rules.comment: Only a budget-approved selection is exposed to the mechanical training-world adapter.

rules.name: ues_suppress_denied_opportunity_without_retry
rules.comment: A budget-denied opportunity remains visible but is not retried at the same evidence epoch.

rules.name: ues_close_selection_useful_progress_from_receipt_and_behavior
rules.comment: Close an evidence attempt only from a same-epoch actual target receipt and measured learner/behavior outcomes.

rules.name: ues_close_selection_no_progress_from_receipt_and_behavior
rules.comment: Close an evidence attempt only from a same-epoch actual target receipt and measured learner/behavior outcomes.
